name: chunked_sgmv_shrink
description: Chunked LoRA shrink (A projection) with signature chunked_sgmv_shrink(x, weights, batch_info, num_slices=1). x is [S,k], weights is [num_loras, num_slices*r, k], and batch_info supplies seg_indptr, weight_indices and permutation. For each segment b, compute out[rows] = x[rows].float() @ weights[w].float().T and cast to x.dtype, where rows=permutation[seg_indptr[b]:seg_indptr[b+1]]. Return a newly allocated [S, num_slices*r] tensor of x.dtype; rows not covered by any segment remain zero. Inputs are not modified. The suite exercises bfloat16 x/weights with num_slices 1 and 3, k up to 4096, and identity or shuffled permutations.
